leads.lead: Qualify a pinned OME-NGFF 0.4 reader against representative instrument exports, units, transforms, pyramids and malformed/ambiguous metadata. No successful reader test is evidenced here.
Test napari 0.9.2 annotation persistence, masks, plugins, keyboard access and supported deployment before adopting it as the UI base.
Track Zarr issue #3516 and PR #4450 through merge, CI and release; review concurrency limitations and retest crash/reopen before selecting a durable write path.
Measure reference versus portable project exchange on the group's actual shared storage, including relocation, source changes, stale copies and filesystem durability.
Consider reader plugins, collaboration, registration and segmentation only after the minimum import, annotation, recovery and export path is qualified.
